name: Z.ai GLM
note: Quota only — Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan is driven through Claude Code, so its sessions are already read by the claude-code harness. The token is the ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN that Claude Code was pointed at, which is where the plan puts it — but that field is shared with every other Anthropic-compatible vendor, so the base URL is checked too before the token is treated as Z.ai's. Z.ai reports two TOKENS_LIMIT rows distinguished only by `unit`, so the window key joins both: keying on `type` alone would collapse the weekly cap into the session one and hide the limit users hit most. The endpoint is published nowhere; checked 2026-09-22, docs.z.ai documents the plan and not this call. The window keys are the part to doubt: other tools report accounts whose replies carry limit kinds this mapping does not name, and such a reply is reported as unreadable rather than drawn as zero — there is a fixture case for it. The mapping is not changed on that evidence, because a field path taken from another tool is a guess about somebody else's product.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.

quota.setupHint: Point Claude Code at Z.ai and sign in.
